visual.face: Hombre maduro de tez clara-oliva cálida. Rostro ovalado relativamente ancho, frente alta con líneas de expresión, cejas oscuras marcadas, nariz recta prominente con punta redondeada, orejas laterales visibles, ojos algo entornados y sonrisa de dientes superiores con pliegues en las mejillas. Barba y bigote cortos canosos, más blancos en el mentón, verificados en fotos reales; las gafas graduadas doradas grandes y redondeadas dejan ver sus ojos.
visual.hair: Castaño oscuro con canas visibles en las sienes; corto peinado de lado con pequeño mechón frontal elevado y entradas. No es un rapado al cero ni una melena.
visual.outfit: Camisa blanca de manga larga con pequeño murciélago negro en pecho izquierdo, pantalones azul marino rectos y zapatillas negras, visibles en el hombre de la izquierda de la publicación oficial 122. Gafas graduadas doradas verificadas en FMUC 2024 y consulta 2026. El diseño combina ese conjunto documentado con su cara y sus gafas de las fotografías más claras. El cuello y los botones de la camisa son interpretación gráfica de una miniatura de baja resolución.

gestures.description: Saludo con palma abierta a la altura de la cara y sonrisa amplia.
Gesto de mano cerca de la cámara durante un mensaje hablado en primer plano.
gestures.evidence: Cuadro real extraído y visto; no se afirma timbre, ritmo ni palabras del audio.

draculaMotif.description: Drácula es una marca pública documentada: aparece nombrada en su caption de Telegram 78, en su línea de ropa de 2019 y en eventos oficiales de Fundadeporte. En el sprite se usa únicamente el pequeño murciélago de la camisa observada; no se inventa indumentaria de vampiro.

visual.previousSpriteComparison: El v1 llevaba lentes negros, traje negro con franjas rojas y zapatillas rojas que no correspondían al conjunto seleccionado. Su cara y mandíbula eran demasiado genéricas. El v2 se rehízo con fotos reales para cara, pelo, barba corta, gafas, nariz, edad visible y ropa; mantiene cuerpo normal y abdomen discreto.
visual.designChoices: Los golpes, saltos, guardia y patadas son poses ficticias de juego. Su porte deportivo documentado no implica entrenamiento real de combate.

sprite.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent 2D fighting-game sprite atlas, 4 columns x 2 rows.
Primary request: Redraw Rafael Lacava, the Venezuelan public figure, as a recognizable editorial caricature using his REAL photographic likeness. Exactly EIGHT full-body separate poses, no extra portraits.
Input images, in order:
1. fmuc-votacion-2024.jpeg: REAL Rafael Lacava. Main reference for face, hair, ears, mature age, closely trimmed salt-and-pepper beard and gold optical glasses. Copy facial likeness, especially his nose, close-set eyes, eyebrows, temples and smiling mouth.
2. consulta-2026.jpg: REAL Rafael Lacava in March 2026. Additional identity reference for profile, receding side-parted brown-gray hair and round gold eyeglasses. Use only face and normal body proportions from this photo.
3. telegram-122-thumb.jpg: REAL Rafael Lacava is the LEFT man, wearing WHITE long-sleeve collared sports shirt with SMALL BLACK BAT emblem on left chest, straight navy blue trousers and plain black sneakers. THIS is the complete outfit reference. DO NOT copy the other man. Preserve white sleeves, navy trousers and black shoes in all poses.
4. delsa.png: ILLUSTRATION STYLE ONLY. Match its clean dark outlines, cel shading, slightly enlarged expressive head and professional arcade caricature finish; do not copy Delsa's identity or clothing.

Face: recognizable mature man in his late fifties, natural light-medium warm olive complexion. Moderately wide oval face, high forehead, visible expression lines, strong dark-gray eyebrows, brown eyes visible through thin large rounded gold optical eyeglasses. Prominent straight nose with rounded tip, natural medium ears visible on the side, smiling slightly asymmetrical mouth with realistic cheek folds. Brown hair mixed with gray at temples, SHORT SIDE-PARTED combed hair with a modest swept forelock and receding corners; no spiky hairstyle. Short neatly close-trimmed salt-and-pepper beard and moustache following his REAL cheeks and chin, no thick full beard, no goatee. Prioritize the specific photo likeness over making a handsome generic fighter.
Body and outfit: normal mature body, modest shoulders, slight abdomen, realistic ordinary arms and legs, natural adult proportions. WHITE long-sleeve collared sports shirt untucked, small BLACK bat silhouette on left chest, deep NAVY straight sports trousers, plain BLACK low-top sneakers. Gold optical eyeglasses are visible in all eight poses. No cap, no sunglasses, no cape, no fang teeth, no watch, no chains, no accessories, no ripped muscles. Drácula motif is represented ONLY by the documented small black bat on the shirt.
Style: polished 2D Venezuelan editorial caricature with carefully faithful facial anatomy, bold clear dark ink outlines, clean three-tone cel shading, slightly enlarged head for recognition at game scale. No pixel art and no photorealistic collage.
Composition: one landscape 2048 x 1024 canvas divided conceptually into EXACTLY 4 columns and EXACTLY 2 rows, each cell 512 x 512. Exactly one complete character per cell, a total of 8 disconnected alpha components. All poses use the same head, facial features, beard, clothing, body scale and proportions. Each full body including hands, feet and hair remains INSIDE its own cell with generous transparent padding on ALL sides. Keep high kick and punch compact enough to avoid adjacent cells. Absolutely no parts touching neighboring bodies, no detached hat, symbols, props or effects. Each body must be one connected alpha component: hands, fingers, legs, spectacles and shirt emblem attached visually to that body.
Every body faces SCREEN-RIGHT in three-quarter side view, head facing screen-right; enough near side of the face visible to recognize his features.
Top row left to right: 1 idle guard with both fists raised; 2 defensive block, forearms crossed in front of chest; 3 running A to the right with left leg forward; 4 running B to the right with right leg forward.
Bottom row left to right: 5 jumping with knees tucked under him; 6 straight right-handed punch aimed right; 7 high side kick aimed right with foot at head level, supporting leg visible; 8 recoiling from pain, leaning backward while still facing right.
Scene/backdrop: REAL FULLY TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND. No ground shadow, floor, painted or checkerboard background, scenic backdrop, frame, panels, grids or borders.
Constraints: EXACTLY 8 bodies in 4 x 2 positions. No words, no text, no numbers, no captions, no watermark, no effects, no motion trails, no detached objects, no floating bat, no duplicate arms or legs. Eight poses only, 4 top and 4 bottom.


SECOND BUILT-IN IMAGEGEN PASS — selected final atlas
Edit this exact transparent 4 x 2 sprite atlas. Keep Rafael Lacava's identity, face, hair, short gray beard, round gold eyeglasses, white shirt with black bat, navy trousers, black shoes, cel shading and all EIGHT poses. Change ONLY the pose in the FOURTH column of the TOP row (the top right running pose). It must show the OTHER half of the running cycle relative to column 3: anatomical RIGHT LEG forward to screen-right and LEFT LEG stretching back to screen-left, with LEFT ARM driving forward and RIGHT ARM sweeping back. Keep his head and torso facing SCREEN-RIGHT in three-quarter view. Make this pose visibly different in leg and arm placement from top row column 3. Keep the other seven bodies unchanged. EXACTLY 8 complete separate bodies, 4 columns x 2 rows. Generous transparent padding between all bodies, no body touching another or the outer image edge. Keep fully transparent alpha background, no text, effects, props, detached objects, extra limbs or extra characters. This is an atlas edit, preserve the real person's likeness.

ASSET PREPARATION
The integrated tool returned a 1774x887 transparent PNG. The eight main alpha components were isolated, keeping adjacent antialias fringes, uniformly scaled by 0.96, and centered into a 2048x1024 4x2 atlas with 512x512 cells. No face or outfit was drawn in code. See assets/references/lacava/atlas-packing.json for all crop bounds and placements.

sprite.preparation: 8 components isolated with their alpha fringes, uniformly scaled 0.96 and centered in eight 512px cells; art itself generated by integrated imagegen.

visualReview.likeness: Frente alta con entradas, cejas oscuras, pelo peinado de lado con canas, nariz prominente, barba corta canosa, gafas ópticas doradas y sonrisa comparadas con fotos reales de 2024 y 2026.
visualReview.padding: Cada cuerpo íntegro está dentro de una celda de 512x512 con margen real transparente; ocho componentes desconectados, cuatro por fila.
visualReview.runCycle: Run B tiene brazos y torso distintos y una zancada más extendida. Las piernas siguen un patrón cercano, sin un intercambio anatómico perfecto entre A y B.

limitations: La miniatura oficial 122 documenta la ropa completa a baja resolución; cuello y botones son interpretación gráfica.
Las carreras A y B varían brazos, torso y amplitud de zancada; las piernas no alternan de forma anatómicamente perfecta.
El recorte original de 2.7s no se auditó por oído y no se ofrece como diálogo verificado o listo para runtime.
Las muestras arcade existentes son interpretaciones de juego, no una grabación ni una clonación de la voz real.
